requirements.value: Separately installed Node.js/npm and ncm-cli following ncm-cli-setup/SKILL.md. Search requires the operator to configure appId and privateKey through ncm-cli config set as documented upstream. The package includes ncm-cli-setup/scripts/install_mpv.py for optional local playback. Installing skills does not install or configure the CLI or provision API credentials.

Apply for appId/privateKey through the NetEase Cloud Music developer platform and keep privateKey in private host configuration, never chat or this public catalog. Account-specific operations additionally need the relevant account authorization. CLI startup is not proof of a successful search; no credentialed search was verified. Service terms, content/region rights, membership and charges apply separately. Verify configuration and stop on missing access or service errors.
